sealed_data_guard: no sealed data opened; DEV only
realization_b_usage: robustness rerun ONLY after full V1 freeze

candidate_universe.keep_drop: all files with in_sparse==True (Sparse write set)
candidate_universe.add: top 20 non-sparse legal production files by frozen Qwen dense_rank (ascending)

features.name: dense_file_score
features.nan_handling: impute to min_finite_dense_score - 1.0 (per realization, label-free, frozen)

features.name: log_rank
features.rank_note: ABSOLUTE rank 1..N; NOT normalized by repository file count N

model.preprocessing: StandardScaler on the 5 continuous features only; fit on training rows only

outer_cv.procedure: within each repo, deterministic shuffle then fold = index % 5

threshold_procedure.objective: argmax pooled micro-F1 on inner-OOF predictions
threshold_procedure.threshold_source: INNER task-grouped OOF within OUTER training tasks ONLY

final_set_construction.rule: include candidate file iff predicted_probability >= outer_training_threshold

primary_success_gate.B: paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound for Delta F1 > 0
primary_success_gate.D: FNR_policy <= FNR_sparse (equivalent to C; interpretability only)
primary_success_gate.E: at least 3/5 outer folds satisfy Delta F1 >= 0
primary_success_gate.G: deterministic local rerun identical OOF predictions and final sets

pareto_success.definition: on BOTH repos P_policy > P_sparse AND R_policy > R_sparse AND F1_policy > F1_sparse AND FNR_policy < FNR_sparse

realization_b_robustness.allowed: refit scaler and LR inside the SAME frozen fold/training procedure

decision_rule.pass: gate passes on BOTH repositories AND realization-B preserves PASS -> CALIBRATED_SET_SELECTION_V1_PASS

competitors.locagent: NOT executed; old F1~0.333 from a DIFFERENT exposed 10-task population; matched-comparison protocol drafted only
competitors.locbench: future external-validity benchmark after policy freeze

roadmap_order_preserved: 1 final calibrated policy on Python DEVELOPMENT
